title: 2389. Longest Subsequence With Limited Sum

examples.explanation: We answer the queries as follows: - The subsequence [2,1] has a sum less than or equal to 3. It can be proven that 2 is the maximum size of such a subsequence, so answer[0] = 2. - The subsequence [4,5,1] has a sum less than or equal to 10. It can be proven that 3 is the maximum size of such a subsequence, so answer[1] = 3. - The subsequence [4,5,2,1] has a sum less than or equal to 21. It can be proven that 4 is the maximum size of such a subsequence, so answer[2] = 4.
The empty subsequence is the only subsequence that has a sum less than or equal to 1, so answer[0] = 0.
